settings.text: 自动化Obsidian 运行期间执行；收起面板不停止任务。打开通知中心打开使用说明打开自动化后，选择“新建自动化”或“编辑”，即可配置该条自动化的通知渠道和会话方式。这些选项按每条自动化设置，不是全局默认值。通知渠道支持应用内和桌面系统通知。邮件、短信需配置服务商，目前尚未启用。会话方式运行智能体时，可在自动化编辑器中选择“每次新建”“沿用上次存活会话”或“指定会话”。沿用模式在没有兼容存活会话时会新建；明确指定的会话不可用时会报错。Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Grok、Pi、OpenCode 使用原生生命周期事件，并保留已有用户 hook。缺少事件时，在进程退出前显示状态未知。CLI 信任提示需要手动完成。

AutomationsRuns while Obsidian is open. Hidden panels keep running.OpenNotificationsOpenUsage guideOpen Automations, then choose New automation or Edit to configure notification channels and session mode for that automation. These are per-automation options, not global defaults.Notification channelsIn-app and desktop system notifications are available. Email and SMS require a delivery provider and remain disabled.SessionFor Run agent actions, choose New each time, Reuse previous live session, or Choose a session in the automation editor. Reuse starts a new session if no compatible live session remains; an unavailable explicitly selected session reports an error.Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Pi and OpenCode use native lifecycle events; existing user hooks are preserved. Missing events remain unverified until process exit. CLI trust prompts must be completed manually.
